title: Unify Board Element Styling States
description: Make board styling consistent across node, edge, handle, and wire. Extend element style support to cover original, neutral, hovered, selected, highlighted, disabled. Add a shared style prop through the board element contract and use it consistently across features. Add a window option for original style, default false, so imported elements such as SVGs can remain unmodified when requested. Validate through focused tests/builds.
summary: Collapsed selected and preselected board chrome onto the highlighted palette across the Rust host and TypeScript fallback/theme serialization, and fixed imperative selection syncing so scene objects always refresh their selected flags after setSelectionIds. Validated with cargo test -p elements_board --lib and bun nx run @elements/board:test; the Nx target is green through Rust, wasm-pack, and Vitest, with the same pre-existing Playwright failures remaining in board-play-gpu.spec.ts lines 21 and 54.
